section.title: Linked family trees
section.none: {name} isn't linked to another family's tree.
section.explain: If {name} is also in another family's tree (for example a husband's or wife's family), you can link the two. Each family keeps its own tree; both see the other's version of {name} and their close family.
section.pending: Link code sent {sent}. It works until {expires}.
section.unlinkExplain: Both families keep their own trees; they just stop seeing each other's version of {name}.
section.namesOnly: Names and years only. Contact details and children's details are never shared.

screen.title: Link trees
screen.heading: Link {name} with another family's tree
screen.intro: Send this code to an owner of the other family's tree. They enter it under “Have a code?” and choose {name} in their tree.
screen.codeNote: It works once and expires in 14 days. It won't be shown again, but you can make a new one.
screen.shareFailed: Couldn't open sharing on this device. Copy the message below instead.

join.preview: {requester} from “{tree}” wants to link their tree with yours through:
join.previewNoRequester: “{tree}” wants to link their tree with yours through:
join.pickTree: Which of your trees is this person in?
join.noOwnedTrees: Only an owner of a family tree can accept a link, and you don't own a tree yet.

errors.notAllowed: Only tree owners can link or unlink trees.
errors.sameTree: Choose someone in a different tree.
errors.minor: Children below the age limit can't be linked.
errors.exists: This person is already linked with that tree.
